target.consumer: stale recovery allocator and 50-worker canary verifier

canonical_identity.problem: stale recovery protocol permits concurrent non-stale recovery claims for the same opportunity because no per-opportunity active-generation fence is atomically enforced
acceptance: A live two-worker recovery race for one stale opportunity yields at most one active nonstale recovery generation and the loser deterministically observes the winner without overwriting.
Recovery eligibility rechecks active recovery claims under the latest host head immediately before create and create-if-absent fencing prevents a second active generation under concurrent starts.
Existing append-only recovery evidence and no-overwrite semantics remain preserved; stale timeout/retry rules and unrelated opportunities are unchanged.
A regression test reproduces the 2026-09-17 kernel double-recovery incident and fails without the fence and passes with it.
